title: Carrier-Damage Goodwill Credit on Marketplace Orders Guarantee Grants
content:
**Schedule.** The carrier-damage credit of the Marketplace Orders guarantee grant counts the units on the order's return requests whose reason is damage in transit: at least the multi-unit damage count of 2 such units earns the per-unit damage credit of USD 5.00 for every such unit; at least the single-unit damage count of 1 but fewer than 2 earns one flat single-unit damage credit of USD 6.00; fewer earn no carrier-damage credit.

Each goodwill credit of the guarantee grant is decided on its own; it is added together with any other goodwill credit of the grant, and what is paid of the credits is added to the amount claimed.

## Credit by units damaged in transit

| Units on return requests with reason damaged in transit | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 | 6.00 (flat) |
| 2 | 2 times 5.00, that is 10.00 |
| 3 | 3 times 5.00, that is 15.00 |

Only the units recorded on return requests whose reason is damaged in transit are counted; units returned for any other reason are not.

### Hypothetical case

An order carrying one return request for 2 units damaged in transit and one for 1 unit as defective counts 2 units and earns USD 10.00.
